faqs.question: What is the difference between WhatsApp Business App and WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer: The free app is limited to one physical smartphone and manual chats. The official Cloud API supports multi-agent CRMs, automated chatbot funnels, green tick verification, and broadcast messaging to tens of thousands of buyers.

faqs.question: How fast does an automated WhatsApp funnel qualify an incoming real estate lead?
faqs.answer: Veloxis automated flows qualify buyer configuration, budget range, purchase timeline, and preferred site visit slots within 42 seconds of clicking a Meta or Google ad.

faqs.question: What is the open rate of WhatsApp messages compared to email in Indian real estate?
faqs.answer: Real estate marketing emails in India average an 8-12% open rate, whereas WhatsApp Business API messages achieve an industry-leading 95-98% open rate, with 80% read within 10 minutes.

faqs.question: Can WhatsApp automation send personalized floor plans and pricing dynamically?
faqs.answer: Yes. Based on whether the buyer clicks '2 BHK' or '3 BHK', the system dynamically delivers the corresponding architectural floor plan PDF, cost sheet, and RERA certificate instantly.

faqs.question: How do developers prevent WhatsApp account bans when broadcasting?
faqs.answer: By using the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API with pre-approved message templates, clear opt-in permissions, and strictly maintaining quality ratings above Medium.

faqs.question: Does the WhatsApp Business API integrate with real estate CRMs?
faqs.answer: Yes. The API integrates seamlessly with Salesforce, LeadSquared, Sell.Do, HubSpot, and custom databases via webhooks and bi-directional REST APIs.

faqs.question: Can buyers book physical site visit appointments directly inside WhatsApp?
faqs.answer: Yes. Interactive date-picker buttons allow prospects to lock in Saturday or Sunday morning slots and receive calendar invites with GPS map directions automatically.

faqs.question: How does WhatsApp automation reduce weekend site visit no-show rates?
faqs.answer: By sending automated GPS location maps 24 hours prior, personalized voice note reminders on the morning of the visit, and simple 1-tap rescheduling buttons.
